description: Implementation of MerchantStore data access object (DAO) for database interactions related to MerchantStore and associated Product retrieval, using Hibernate and QueryDSL.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDaoImpl
classes.description: Data access object implementation for MerchantStore entities, providing methods to retrieve products and merchant store details.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of Product objects associated with a given MerchantStore, executing an HQL query with various fetch joins.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its ID using QueryDSL.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its code or ID using QueryDSL.
